renderSubtitles.text:
Third lantern, then left...
it has to be here.

Nico! I almost walked
right past you.

Two years, and you still pick
the hardest street in Tokyo to find.

Hardest to find,
easiest to love.

Fine. Make mine
the strong one.

So tell me everything.
What happened to the studio?
You just... vanished.

The lease ended. Everyone said quit.
So I bought a coffee machine.

A coffee machine. Of course you did.
And people cross the whole city for it?
Then I'm in the right place.
I'll keep the strong one warm.
